checks.summary: Directus extension build and TypeScript no-emit check

findings.impact_claim_reviewer_field: impact_claim.reviewer_id references staff.id; it is not a Directus user identifier.
findings.identity_mapping: No explicit authenticated-operator-to-staff mapping exists. operator_governance_party_binding identifies a canonical party, not a staff record.
findings.behavior: Impact-claim review transitions still stamp review_date but no longer copy accountability.user into reviewer_id. An explicitly supplied staff ID is preserved and remains subject to tenant-reference validation.

limitations: This is unit/source verification, not live Directus or database acceptance.
Authenticated operator-to-staff identity binding remains an owner decision and implementation prerequisite for verified staff attribution.
No migration, candidate database, legacy database, provider, or live service was used.
rollback: Keep reviewer_id unset when no verified staff mapping is available. Reintroduce automatic attribution only after an explicit, reviewed mapping and matching scoped tests exist.
